lines.t: Verse 1:
I’ve walked through shadows, fought the lies,
Searching for truth behind my eyes.
Every tear that hit the ground,
You caught before I could drown.
Pre-Chorus:
When I’m breaking, You’re the sound
That pulls me up from the ground.
Chorus:
You breathe in the light where I had none,
You lift my face to the rising sun.
Even when I fall apart,
Your love ignites my heart.
You breathe in the light, You breathe in the light.
Verse 2:
My doubts still whisper, but You stay near,
Turning my chaos into prayer and tears.
Every scar is mercy’s flame,
I’m not lost, You know my name.
Even in silence, I can hear
Your voice saying, I am here.
Chorus:
You breathe in the light where I had none,
You lift my face to the rising sun.
Even when I fall apart,
Your love ignites my heart.
You breathe in the light, You breathe in the light.
Bridge:
In the breaking, You are holy,
In the waiting, You still hold me.
I was dead, but now I see —
Your light’s alive in me.
Final Chorus:
You breathe in the light where I had none,
You lift my face to the rising sun.
I’ll sing through the dark of night —
Your love is my fight.
You breathe in the light, You breathe in the light.
